notes: Method: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch + WebFetch rendering) only; no block encountered so Playwright/Chrome not needed. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic User-agent: * rules only; disallows /cart, /profile, /auth, /wishlist, /products?q=, and the raw category_l1/l2/l3/brand/custom sitemap XML files from crawlers - respected by not bulk-fetching those specific sitemap files). Discovery: fetched sitemap.xml index, then the two explicitly-listed (non-disallowed) Sitemap: entries collection.sitemap.xml (1016 URLs - this site's 'collection' path is its thematic/curated PLP taxonomy) and sections.sitemap.xml (site nav sections), plus homepage HTML, for every holiday/festival keyword (diwali, christmas, xmas, halloween, holi, rakhi/raksha, valentine, thanksgiving, new-year, eid, navratri, onam, pongal, easter, mother/father's day, festive, santa, ganesh/lakshmi/pooja, diya/rangoli/toran/lantern/garland/candle). Also ran /products?q= internal search for diwali/christmas/rakhi/raksha-bandhan/holi/new-year/valentine as a supplementary (non-authoritative) discovery check, and checked the rendered sections/interiors mega-menu for any festival-named entries. FOUND: exactly two genuine Diwali collections - collection/diwali-lanterns and collection/diwali-lights-decoration - both real curated PLPs (own URL, own meta title/description e.g. 'Buy Diwali Lanterns online in India... Shop for the variety Collections of the table lamps, hanging lights, floor lamps...'), grids of decorative lighting products (lamps/hanging lights) explicitly branded and marketed as Diwali decor, matching the allowed 'genuine Diwali Decor PLP with real product grid' case, not excluded for topical overlap with the general Lighting category. Site's own on-page product-count widget is broken/inflated (showed nonsense values like '3662 Products' / '487 Products' alongside a literal 'Showing 0 of 0' footer, consistent with prior findings that Shopify/storefront count widgets on this platform class of site are unreliable) so qty was NOT taken from the display; instead verified via full grid enumeration (distinct product slugs/names in the rendered page): 12 products on diwali-lanterns, 12 products on diwali-lights-decoration - no pagination/'show more' controls were functional to reveal further pages, so this is the complete set. EXCLUDED as not genuine seasonal categories: collection/festive-price-drop and collection/festive-price-drops - these are generic storewide festive-SEASON discount/clearance pages (meta description lists an unrelated grab-bag of furniture: 'bedside table, study chair, 3 seater sofa, console table...'), matching the explicit boundary rule that a storewide sale/clearance page is not a genuine seasonal category. The nav label 'Festive Lights' (seen under sections/interiors Lighting menu) resolves to collection/outdoor-lights, a generic outdoor-lighting PLP with no holiday-specific naming/content - excluded as a mislabeled generic category, not a real festival PLP. collection/pooja-mandirs is a year-round religious-furniture item (puja altars/mandirs), not tied to any specific calendar holiday - excluded. ABSENCE CHECKS: Christmas/Xmas, Halloween, Holi, Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, Navratri, Onam, Pongal, Easter, Mother's Day, Father's Day - none appear anywhere in the full 1016-URL collection taxonomy, the sections/nav taxonomy, or the homepage; supplementary internal-search checks for rakhi, raksha-bandhan, holi, and valentine returned 0 results, christmas returned only 3 unrelated hits, and new-year's 88 hits were generic keyword matches on a raw ?q= search page (not a taxonomy PLP, so not eligible as a row per the genuine-PLP test) with no dedicated New Year category/URL existing anywhere in the sitemap. Diwali was checked with particular thoroughness per task instructions given Urban Ladder is a major Indian home/furniture retailer, and both genuine Diwali PLPs found were included.
